title: Mit mondott? Függő beszéd és nézőpontváltás (Review: What Did They Say? Reported Speech)
grammar: Direct & Indirect Speech, Tense Retention and Deictic Shifts in Hungarian

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can report what someone said with azt mondta, hogy ….
I can change én to ő and itt, ma, holnap to ott, aznap, másnap.
I can name a statement, a quotation and a message.
I can tell reported speech from a direct quotation.
